== Published English Original Virtual Set 2 wording ==
The early slip targets a character at the named Senate and loses the Effect on that character’s arrival. The remaster identifies the Galactic Senate and cancels the Utinni Effect on arrival. Both preserve the 2-Force deployment on an opponent’s site, the leader option and cancellation of the target’s game text. The printed title introduces a hyphen.
